title: v2.0.0 - Global Top 10 Frontier AI & Official AI Agents Matrix
release_notes:
### 🌐 Global Top 10 Frontier AI & Official AI Agents Matrix

- **Expanded to Top 10 Mainstream AI Ecosystems**: Comprehensive coverage of Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Alibaba Qwen, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, Microsoft Copilot, xAI Grok, Meta Muse, and ByteDance Doubao.
- **Mandatory Official AI Agents Roster**: DeepSeek Coder & Agent, GitHub Copilot Workspace & CLI, Grok DeepSearch & Coding Agent, Meta Muse Personal Agent, and Trae AI Native Agent alongside Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, Qwen Code, and Mistral Vibe.
- **Mobile-First 10-Brand Touch Swiping**: 10 brand-emblem squircle icon ribbons with touch-scrolling and centered modal popups.
- **Full Bilingual Localization**: Complete dual-language support (English & Chinese) across all 10 model families and agent changelogs.
